items.q: What kept happening after years with the same agent?
items.a: It **repeated the same mistakes** across sessions and teammates.
Past a point, more context **raises cost/latency** and can **hurt accuracy**.
**Add/update/deactivate** notes; keep **inactive** ones as the judgment trail.

items.q: What new model capability helps the system self-improve?
items.a: Models strong enough to act as a **verifier** layer with less human review.
